message: XVatsim 2.0.0 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases.
release_notes: Adds VATSIM METAR, VATSIM ATIS, and one-shot xPilot waiting-message PDC information drawers.
Strengthens US Approach and Departure selection with vNAS sector evidence and airport-relative terminal transmitter distance.
Prevents unchanged ATIS content from repeatedly returning to unread.
Moves route and authority preparation away from the X-Plane flight loop while preserving Brain-owned decisions.
